raw_response:
This plot is small, only a small piece of my land, but wheat is important for our family's food. I went to school a few years so I know fertilizer helps, and last season my neighbor got a better harvest using DAP at planting and some urea later — I will try to do the same but only one small bag because cash is tight. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest since improved wheat seed from the cooperative is expensive and not always available when I need it. My husband and I will do all the work ourselves with our ox, no money to hire anyone.
